_help: Linux/macOS version of winxmerge-compare.windows.json. winxmerge is a personal cargo-built, cross-platform diff/merge tool (`cargo install` puts it in ~/.cargo/bin); "cmd" is looked up on PATH, so use an absolute path if Waydir is started without it. Swap "cmd" for meld, kdiff3 or another tool taking <left> <right> if you don't have it. Compare-mode launcher: Enter on a file that exists on both sides opens it in the tool. %LEFT%/%RIGHT% are the left/right pane files. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: Merge in WinXMerge
